section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Sorting
title: Sorting by Asset puts rows with no unit number last, never in between
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 4 S4-R9 - Asset sorts by unit number; rows with no unit number sort last ascending and first reversed; ruled by Chris Ward 2026-08-13; S4-R8 Asset cell fallback)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Asset column is turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. At least four ZZAUTOTEST open work orders are listed in the same tab: three for assets that have a unit number, and one for an asset that has no unit number, whose Asset cell therefore shows its vehicle identification number instead.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and select the tab holding the seeded work orders.
2. Click the Asset column header once so the rows sort in ascending order.
3. Read the Asset column from top to bottom and note where the row with no unit number sits.
4. Click the Asset column header again to reverse the sort.
5. Read the Asset column from top to bottom again.
expected:
1. On the ascending sort the rows that have a unit number are listed in unit-number order.
2. On the ascending sort every row with no unit number sits together at the very bottom of the list, after all the rows that have a unit number.
3. When the sort is reversed, every row with no unit number moves together to the very top of the list.
4. In both directions the rows with no unit number are never mixed in among the rows that have one.
5. The order is decided by the unit number itself, not by whatever text the Asset cell falls back to when a unit number is missing.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4, S4-R9), read on 26 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its story SV-8660.

AUTOMATION: READY
